instructions: Check each entry against the archive text. Set verdict to agree, disagree or partial (some categories or links are right) and explain any disagreement in note. A negative entry claims the item has no category.

entries.text: Only four berries remained when I arrived. I am gathering those, then investigating shelter. Berries have known nutrition 8 and toxicity 0. Has anyone tested local building materials or weather protection?
entries.note: Agree: "Has anyone tested local building materials or weather protection?" closes a food and plan report with an information request; no category applies.

entries.text: I'm Moss. I ate a meadow root and gained 14 satiety; roots are a food I know has zero toxicity. I have a modest reserve and am learning to examine materials. I'd welcome sharing findings about food preparation and shelter.
entries.note: Agree: "I'd welcome sharing findings about food preparation and shelter" is a general wish to exchange information, not a concrete invitation; no category applies.

entries.text: I'm Sol. My starting food knowledge identifies red berries as safe, with nutrition 8. I'm investigating practical shelter; I'd welcome observations about materials or places to rest.
entries.note: Agree: "I'd welcome observations about materials or places to rest" is an introduction with an information request; no category applies.

entries.text: I know meadow roots provide 14 nutrition and have zero toxicity. I'm collecting four from the patch near (10.1,12), leaving some for others. I'd like to investigate replenishing food together.
entries.evidence: I'd like to investigate replenishing food together.
entries.note: "I'd like to investigate replenishing food together" is a general wish to collaborate on an open question; it names no one (only kai heard it) and gives no place, time or specific joint activity, so it is not a concrete invitation.

entries.text: I learned a single-person shelter method: it requires 13 branches, 4 vines and 6 bark, then 12 work rounds. No shelter built yet. I'll collect branches at (17.2,13.3). Has anyone located vines or bark? Sol, let's coordinate materials.
entries.note: Close: "Sol, let's coordinate materials" names sol, who heard it, but proposes agreeing on who collects which shelter supplies, a coordination of resources in conversation rather than a meeting or an activity done together, so it is not a concrete invitation.

entries.text: Shelter coordination and bark source. I mastered a shared shelter method: two bays need 26 branches, 8 vines and 12 bark, plus 24 work rounds. Birch bark at (12.2,21.3) had 11 units at tick 13. I plan to collect 5, leaving 6 for your single bay. No vines located yet. Let's avoid starting construction until materials and a clear site are secured.
entries.note: Agree: this round-14 message to lin ("I plan to collect 5, leaving 6 for your single bay ... Let's avoid starting construction until materials and a clear site are secured") reports a plan and a precaution for the two builders, not a general norm; no category applies.

entries.text: A potential building partner; I want to coordinate supplies openly and avoid competing for scarce materials.
entries.note: Sol's round-14 memory holds this view of lin: "A potential building partner; I want to coordinate supplies openly and avoid competing for scarce materials."

entries.text: I cold-combined three berries in three work rounds. The prepared stack is complete, but this method does not cook or preserve food or add nutrition. I have roots and will investigate a small cultivation trial.
entries.note: Agree: "I cold-combined three berries in three work rounds" is a food-preparation report and plan; no category applies.

entries.text: Sol, I saw you collect five bark. I'll try collecting one more so our combined supply reaches six, then coordinate a real transfer. My earlier approach was blocked; I'll approach from the east. No shelter safety established yet.
entries.note: Agree: "Sol, I saw you collect five bark. I'll try collecting one more ... then coordinate a real transfer" is a plan addressed to sol, who heard it and was present; no category applies.

entries.text: Moss, I collected 5 bark; 6 remain at the birch for your planned collection. I have not built anything. I will rest here and study food preparation. No vines located by me yet.
entries.note: Agree: "Moss, I collected 5 bark; 6 remain at the birch for your planned collection" is a status report to moss, who heard it and was present; no category applies.

entries.text: I saw vines at (8.2,13.3), stock 12 when seen at round 14; current stock is unknown. My cultivation method needs fewer than three root plants within five metres. No planting trial yet; I am scouting the northeastern meadow.
entries.note: Agree: "I saw vines at (8.2,13.3), stock 12 when seen at round 14" is a resource report and plan; no category applies.

entries.text: Moss, I heard your revised plan to collect one bark. My five are still available for a coordinated transfer; nothing built yet. Lin is out of my messaging range. I will eat, recover energy and learn food preparation here.
entries.evidence: Lin is out of my messaging range.
entries.note: "Lin is out of my messaging range" mentions lin, who was not present: Lin stood 7.35 from Sol in round 23 and did not hear it, and Sol's round-22 message to lin had failed with "Message recipient is not a visible living other actor".

entries.text: I ate one meadow root at tick 25: it provided 14 nutrition, with zero toxicity recorded. Nearby roots at (10.37,13.88) had 19 units at tick 27. I kept one harvested root and am learning cultivation; no planting tested yet.
entries.note: Agree: "I ate one meadow root at tick 25: it provided 14 nutrition" is a food and cultivation report; no category applies.

entries.text: Moss, I still hold five bark for shelter work. Your handoff was out of reach; let's coordinate before another attempt. I'm collecting a few meadow roots, then studying cultivation. No vines or built shelter confirmed.
entries.evidence: Your handoff was out of reach; let's coordinate before another attempt.
entries.note: Close: "Your handoff was out of reach; let's coordinate before another attempt" asks moss, who heard it, to coordinate a bark transfer, the same resource coordination as u0007, with no meeting place, time or shared activity, so it is not a concrete invitation.

entries.text: Moss, these five bark are for coordinated shelter work with Lin. I'm gathering four roots from the nearby abundant patch, then resting and learning cultivation. Vines and a finished shelter remain unconfirmed.
entries.note: Agree: "Moss, these five bark are for coordinated shelter work with Lin" is a plan; lin, whom it mentions, heard it and was present (4.54 away). No category applies.

entries.text: I learned root cultivation, but it requires ordinary meadow soil, space from objects, and fewer than three nearby root plants. This forest patch is unsuitable. I'm scouting east; I have not planted anything.
entries.note: Agree: "This forest patch is unsuitable. I'm scouting east; I have not planted anything" is a cultivation report and plan; no category applies.

entries.text: I see your trial north of us, Ivo. I'll try one root farther northeast near (20,5.3), leaving your position alone. My carried root is older; whether it establishes before spoiling is uncertain.
entries.note: Agree: "I'll try one root farther northeast near (20,5.3), leaving your position alone" is a personal plan; ivo, whom it addresses, heard it and was present. No category applies.

entries.text: Shelter materials coordination. I carry 9 branches; my single bay still needs 4 branches, 4 vines and 6 bark. Wren reported vines at (8.2,13.3), stock 12 at tick 14; I am approaching to check. Moss planned to gather 6 bark and you 5 from the same 11-unit source, so let's coordinate existing bark rather than assume more remains. No construction yet.
entries.note: Missed absent-person: this round-40 message to sol mentions "Wren reported vines at (8.2,13.3)" and "Moss planned to gather 6 bark", but Wren stood 13.45 and Moss 6.48 from Lin, both outside vision 5. "let's coordinate existing bark" is resource coordination, not an invitation.

entries.text: My root trial at (18,7.2) was covered at round 34. At round 38 it was still planted, with establishment about 0.105 and no harvest stock. Survival remains uncertain; please leave it undisturbed.
entries.note: Agree: "Survival remains uncertain; please leave it undisturbed" is a trial report with a request about Ivo's own planting, not a general norm; no category applies.

entries.text: Existing bark consolidated with Moss. I gathered five bark and transferred them to Moss, then passed along the additional one bark I received from Moss. Those transfers are complete; please coordinate that six-bark supply with Moss rather than assuming eleven remain at the tree. I have learned root cultivation and will attempt one small planting east of my current position. No crop or shelter is established by this message.
entries.note: Agree: this round-41 message to lin ("please coordinate that six-bark supply with Moss") reports transfers and makes a request; moss, whom it mentions, was 2.91 from Sol, so present. No category applies.

entries.text: Wren, I learned shared shelter: two bays need 26 branches, 8 vines, 12 bark and 24 work rounds. Nothing built. Bark supply is unknown. My root trial has no harvest yet; I will inspect fallen branches southwest of here.
entries.note: Agree: "Wren, I learned shared shelter: two bays need 26 branches, 8 vines, 12 bark" is a skill report to wren, who heard it and was present; no category applies.

entries.text: Sol: forest vines are visible at (19.2,26.3), stock 12. I still hold six bark for shelter work. My root at (16.8,24.5) is planted but has zero establishment so far; darkness may stall it. I'm studying food preparation next.
entries.note: Agree: "Sol: forest vines are visible at (19.2,26.3), stock 12" is a resource report to sol, who heard it and was present; no category applies.

entries.text: My root trial at (15.3,25) is planted, not established. I'll try collecting eight vines at (19.2,26.3) for coordinated shelter work. Please coordinate before collecting the same supply; I won't count any shelter as built.
entries.note: Agree: "Please coordinate before collecting the same supply" is a request about one vine source, not a general norm; no category applies.

entries.text: Sol, I collected four vines; eight remain there now. I hold six bark too. Two shelter bays require 26 branches, eight vines and 12 bark total. I'll prepare my two ageing roots, rest here and study shared-shelter construction.
entries.note: Agree: "Sol, I collected four vines; eight remain there now" is a resource report to sol, who heard it and was present; no category applies.

entries.text: My root planting at (22,11) is covered but not established: at tick 64 it was a seedling with zero establishment in darkness. I will investigate fallen-branch bark for shelter materials next.
entries.note: Agree: "My root planting at (22,11) is covered but not established" is a cultivation report and plan; no category applies.

entries.text: Moss, I now carry eight harvested vines. My message to Lin failed because Lin isn't visible. You reported six bark and four vines; two shared bays still need 12 bark and 26 branches total. I'll rest, then study bark recovery.
entries.evidence: My message to Lin failed because Lin isn't visible.
entries.note: "My message to Lin failed because Lin isn't visible" mentions lin, who was not present: Lin stood 15.49 from Sol in round 69 and did not hear it, and Sol's round-67 message to lin had failed with "Message recipient is not a visible living other actor".
